description: Every Amazon.jobs feature, plus a local job store, new-since diffing, and aggregation Amazon's own site can't do — no login required.

novel_features.name: New-since diff
novel_features.description: See only the Amazon reqs that appeared since you last synced a saved search — no more re-scanning the whole list every morning.

novel_features.name: Saved searches
novel_features.description: Persist a named query plus its filters and diff cursor so a search and its new-since state survive between runs.

novel_features.name: Facet aggregation
novel_features.description: Count synced reqs grouped by city, state, team, or category — the aggregation Amazon's own empty facets[] never returns.

novel_features.name: Qualification-demand scan
novel_features.description: Rank teams and cities by how many synced reqs demand a given skill keyword in their basic/preferred qualifications.

novel_features.name: Pipeline facet filters
novel_features.description: Filter live results by intern, manager, university, and schedule type — fields the .json endpoint silently ignores as server params.
